# Tachyon Intelligence

> Tachyon Intelligence is an Indian AI technology company building voice AI for Indian languages (Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, English), business automation, inventory intelligence and NFC products. Tagline: "Intelligence at the Speed of Thought."

This is a single-page website. Sections are anchors on the home page. Product demonstrations on the site use simulated data and are not connected to live services.

## Site sections
- [Home](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#home): Overview — AI technology and infrastructure, India
- [Technology](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#technology): Intelligence, automation and connectivity
- [Solutions — Voice AI](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#solutions): Voice AI designed for Indian languages, with a scripted demo
- [Inventory intelligence](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#inventory): AI-powered inventory management (fictional demo data)
- [Products — NFC](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#products): NFC business, review and portfolio cards; metal, acrylic, PVC; custom-branded
- [About](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#about): Principles the company works to
- [Contact](https://tachyonintelligence.si/#contact): Enquiry form (hands off to WhatsApp), phone numbers
